text:
maya: Quick sync — we need to align multi-vendor press orchestration + SI cert gating for upcoming H100/H200/B200, MI300 and Gaudi waves. High level asks: embargo windows, marketplace on-ramp dates, SI readiness, and any kernel/driver gating. Can folks triage by EOD?

raj: Re: infra — H100 changes require kernel roll to include new cuBLAS kernels; that takes ~5 business days if we schedule a focused rollout. H200/B200 mostly config. MI300 needs driver 1.14 and our patched runtime — still validating perf regressions.

ben (partner-ops): @maya assigning me to collect SI cert statuses. Current snapshot (quick):
- SI Alpha: H100 + Gaudi validated, MI300 partial (quant tests failing)
- SI Beta: H200/B200 staging only
I'll upload full matrix to the partnership drive by 3pm.

sophia: From comms — marketing wants a 1-week embargo window and a single coordinated announcement date with partner logos locked 48h before publish. Prefer the week of May 11-17 to avoid other product press. Can we confirm gating by May 4?

raj: May 4 gating is tight for MI300 unless we isolate MI300 as a phased announcement (announce H100/H200/B200 + Gaudi first, MI300 in a follow-up). That would also reduce risk for marketplace rollout.

maya: Good call. Proposal: 2-phase announcement. Phase A (compute + custom silicon): H100/H200/B200 + Gaudi on May 14 (embargo week May 11-17). Phase B: MI300 2 weeks later (May 28) if certs clear. Thoughts?

ben (partner-ops): That sequencing works for SI scheduling. I can push SI Beta to prioritize MI300 tests in the coming week to try to make Phase B earlier if needed.

alex (legal): Reminder: partners require logo & trademark signoff 72 hours before publish. Also need to confirm any joint statement language — please route drafts to legal@redwood with subject "partner announce review".

announce-bot: Proposed embargo metadata posted: embargo_start=2026-05-11, embargo_end=2026-05-17, primary_date=2026-05-14. (Automated note: update the embargo record if dates change) :information_source:

maya: Action items:
- ben: full SI cert matrix (due today 15:00 PT)
- raj: confirm kernel/driver impacts and drop-in checklist (due tomorrow noon)
- sophia: draft joint announcement language and asset checklist (first pass by EOD)
- alex: confirm logo/T&C timeline (reply by EOD)

raj: Quick technical checklist snippet for release engineers (copy/paste):
```
- kernel: roll cuBLAS v2.3 patch
- runtime: runtime-2.1.0 + mi300-driver-1.14 (opt-in for MI300 phase)
- quant jobs: run 5x regression traces on sample workloads
- fallback: enable model-variant routing for MI300 traffic if perf dip > 10%
```

maya: If we can hit these owners/dates, marketing can lock press slots tomorrow. If blockers, we fallback to the phased plan and announce the first wave only.

sophia: I'll tentatively book press week May 11-17 and flag press contacts it's a "tentative coordinated partner announcement" — will only send embargo invites once we have legal + partner signoff.

ben (partner-ops): Uploading the matrix now — link incoming in thread. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team. Follow up in this thread with any immediate blockers.
